# Bimanual coupling (L<->R correlation) and asymmetry   #
def compute_arm_coupling(df, joints=("wrist", "elbow"), dims=("x", "y"), absolute=True):
    """Compute correlation between left and right arm movements across specified joints and dimensions.

    Args:
        df: DataFrame containing kinematic data with columns named as 'left_{joint}_{dim}' and 'right_{joint}_{dim}'
        joints: Tuple of joint names to analyze (default: wrist and elbow)
        dims: Tuple of dimensions to analyze (default: x and y)
        absolute: If True, return absolute correlation values (default: True)

    Returns:
        Mean correlation between left and right arm movements across specified joints and dimensions,
        or NaN if no valid pairs are found.
    """
    corrs = []
    for j in joints:
        for d in dims:
            lc, rc = f"left_{j}_{d}", f"right_{j}_{d}"
            if lc in df.columns and rc in df.columns:
                c = np.corrcoef(df[lc], df[rc])[0, 1]
                corrs.append(abs(c) if absolute else c)
    return np.nanmean(corrs) if corrs else np.nan

def compute_arm_asymmetry(df):
    """Compute asymmetry between left and right arm movements by comparing absolute speed sums.

    Args:
        df: DataFrame containing kinematic data with columns named as 'left_{joint}_speed' and 'right_{joint}_speed'

    Returns:
        Mean asymmetry between left and right arm movements across all joints,
        where negative values indicate right arm dominance and positive values indicate left arm dominance,
        or NaN if no valid pairs are found.
    """
    diffs = []
    for j in ARM_JOINTS:
        lc, rc = f"left_{j}_speed", f"right_{j}_speed"
        if lc in df.columns and rc in df.columns:
            diffs.append(np.nansum(np.abs(df[lc])) - np.nansum(np.abs(df[rc])))
    return np.nanmean(diffs) if diffs else np.nan

Inspired by Pouw et al. (2020)

# Wavelet rhythmicity (3 bands)  
def wavelet_rhythmicity(speed, time, bands=((1.0, 2.0), (2.0, 3.0), (3.0, 5.0)),
                        n_freqs=60, wavelet="cmor1.5-1.0", fs=None,
                        min_valid_frac=0.25, plot=False):
    """Wavelet band metrics for a kinematic speed signal.

    Changes vs. the original:
      - sampling rate taken from `time` (fs only used as a consistency check)
      - signal demeaned before the CWT (speed is >= 0; the offset creates edge steps)
      - power rectified by scale (Liu et al., 2007) to remove the low-frequency bias
      - cone of influence (COI) masked before time-averaging
      - peak frequency only reported for a true local maximum inside the band
        (otherwise NaN), so a decaying spectrum no longer yields "peak = lower edge"
      - band entropy normalised by log(n_bins) so bands of different width compare

    Args:
        speed: speed signal (array-like)
        time: time stamps in seconds (array-like, same length)
        bands: frequency bands (Hz) as (low, high) tuples
        n_freqs: number of linearly spaced analysis frequencies
        wavelet: pywt complex Morlet name, "cmorB-C"
        fs: optional sampling rate, checked against `time`
        min_valid_frac: minimum fraction of samples outside the COI for a
            frequency row to be used
        plot: draw scalogram (COI shaded) and mean spectrum (log y)

    Returns:
        dict with, per band: band_power (relative to all usable power in the
        analysed range), centroid, peak_freq (NaN if no interior peak),
        entropy (0-1), coverage (fraction of band bins outside COI limits).
    """
    speed = np.asarray(speed, float)
    time = np.asarray(time, float)
    if np.isnan(speed).any():
        ok = ~np.isnan(speed)
        speed = np.interp(time, time[ok], speed[ok])

    dt = np.median(np.diff(time))
    if fs is not None and not np.isclose(fs, 1 / dt, rtol=0.01):
        raise ValueError(f"fs={fs} but time vector implies {1 / dt:.3f} Hz")

    x = speed - speed.mean()

    fmin = min(b[0] for b in bands)
    fmax = max(b[1] for b in bands)
    freqs = np.linspace(fmin, fmax, n_freqs)
    scales = pywt.central_frequency(wavelet) / (freqs * dt)
    coef, _ = pywt.cwt(x, scales, wavelet, sampling_period=dt)
    power = np.abs(coef) ** 2 / scales[:, None]  # bias rectification

    # Cone of influence: e-folding time of edge effects = sqrt(2) * sigma_t
    B, C = (float(v) for v in wavelet[4:].split("-"))
    sigma_t = C * np.sqrt(B / 2) / freqs           # seconds
    efold = np.sqrt(2) * sigma_t
    t = time - time[0]
    T = t[-1]
    coi = (t[None, :] >= efold[:, None]) & (t[None, :] <= T - efold[:, None])
    valid_frac = coi.mean(axis=1)
    usable = valid_frac >= max(min_valid_frac, 1e-9)

    mp = np.full(n_freqs, np.nan)
    if usable.any():
        mp[usable] = np.nanmean(np.where(coi, power, np.nan)[usable], axis=1)
    total = np.nansum(mp)
    mp_rel = mp / total if total > 0 else mp

    out = {"clip_dur_s": float(T)}
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(bands):
        key = f"band{i + 1}"
        upper = (freqs <= b) if np.isclose(b, fmax) else (freqs < b)
        m = (freqs >= a) & upper
        mu = m & usable
        out[f"{key}_coverage"] = float(mu.sum() / max(m.sum(), 1))
        if mu.sum() == 0 or np.nansum(mp_rel[mu]) == 0:
            for k in ("band_power", "centroid", "peak_freq", "entropy"):
                out[f"{key}_{k}"] = np.nan
            continue
        bf, bp = freqs[mu], mp_rel[mu]
        p = bp / bp.sum()
        out[f"{key}_band_power"] = float(bp.sum())
        out[f"{key}_centroid"] = float(np.sum(bf * p))
        # interior local maxima of the full spectrum that fall inside this band
        idx = np.where(mu)[0]
        peaks = [k for k in idx if 0 < k < n_freqs - 1
                 and mp_rel[k] > mp_rel[k - 1] and mp_rel[k] > mp_rel[k + 1]]
        out[f"{key}_peak_freq"] = (float(freqs[max(peaks, key=lambda k: mp_rel[k])])
                                   if peaks else np.nan)
        out[f"{key}_entropy"] = (float(-np.sum(p * np.log(p + 1e-12)) / np.log(len(p)))
                                 if len(p) > 1 else np.nan)

    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 7),
                                       gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [3, 1]})
        im = ax1.imshow(np.log10(power + 1e-12), aspect="auto", origin="lower",
                        extent=[time[0], time[-1], freqs[0], freqs[-1]], cmap="viridis")
        ax1.fill_betweenx(freqs, time[0], np.minimum(time[0] + efold, time[-1]),
                          color="w", alpha=0.35, lw=0)
        ax1.fill_betweenx(freqs, np.maximum(time[-1] - efold, time[0]), time[-1],
                          color="w", alpha=0.35, lw=0)
        for (a, b) in bands:
            ax1.axhline(a, color="w", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.6)
            ax1.axhline(b, color="w", lw=0.8, ls="--", alpha=0.6)
        fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax1, label="log10(rectified power)")
        ax1.set_ylabel("Frequency (Hz)")
        ax1.set_xlabel("Time (s)")
        ax1.set_title("Wavelet scalogram of speed (shaded = cone of influence)")
        ax2.semilogy(freqs, mp_rel, color="k")
        for i, (a, b) in enumerate(bands):
            ax2.axvspan(a, b, alpha=0.15, color=f"C{i}", label=f"band{i + 1} {a}-{b} Hz")
        ax2.set_xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
        ax2.set_ylabel("rel. power (log)")
        ax2.legend(fontsize=8)
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

    return out

# Proximalization index (rel/abs)   
# wrist absolute speed includes elbow transport; wrist relspeed is elbow-removed articulation.
# ratio -> 0 : wrist just carried by the arm (proximalized).  ratio -> 1 : independent forearm
# rotation (distal). Mean over available arm joints that have a relspeed column.
def get_proximalization_index(df):
    """Calculate the proximalization index by computing the ratio of relative to absolute speeds
    for wrist and elbow joints across both sides. Returns the mean ratio or NaN if no valid data."""
    ratios = []
    for side in SIDES:
        for j in ("wrist", "elbow"):
            ab, rel = f"{side}_{j}_speed", f"{side}_{j}_relspeed"
            if ab in df.columns and rel in df.columns:
                a = df[ab].to_numpy(); r = df[rel].to_numpy()
                denom = np.nanmedian(a)
                if denom > 1e-9:
                    ratios.append(np.nanmedian(r) / denom)
    return np.nanmean(ratios) if ratios else np.nan

def feature_adjacent_fingertip_spread(df, side):
    """Mean & std of adjacent fingertip gaps (thumb-index, index-middle, ...)."""
    cols = [dist_col(side, 4, 8), dist_col(side, 8, 12),
            dist_col(side, 12, 16), dist_col(side, 16, 20)]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c in df.columns]

    return df[cols].mean().mean(), df[cols].mean().std()

def feature_thumb_index_distance(df, side):                # aperture / pinch
    """Calculate mean and standard deviation of thumb-index distance."""
    c = dist_col(side, 4, 8)
    return (df[c].mean(), df[c].std()) if c in df.columns else (np.nan, np.nan)

def feature_mcp_tip_distance(df, side):                     # overall flexion (tip->MCP)
    """Mean & std of MCP-tip distances (thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky)."""
    cols = [dist_col(side, FINGER_TIP_ID[f], FINGER_MCP_ID[f])
            for f in ["thumb","index","middle","ring","pinky"]]
    cols = [c for c in cols if c in df.columns]
    if not cols: return np.nan, np.nan
    return df[cols].mean().mean(), df[cols].mean().std()

    c = dist_col(side, 4, FINGER_MCP_ID["pinky"])

# Fingertip dynamics 
def _tip_mcp_speed_cols(df, side):
    """Identifies and returns columns in the DataFrame that contain speed data between fingertip and MCP joints for specified fingers (excluding thumb)."""
    cols = [f"{dist_col(side, FINGER_TIP_ID[f], FINGER_MCP_ID[f])}_speed"
            for f in ["index","middle","ring","pinky"]]     # thumb handled separately
    return [c for c in cols if c in df.columns]

def feature_fingertip_speed(df, side):                      
    """Calculates the mean and standard deviation of fingertip speed between MCP and fingertip joints for specified fingers (excluding thumb)."""
    cols = _tip_mcp_speed_cols(df, side)
    if not cols: return np.nan, np.nan
    return df[cols].mean().mean(), df[cols].mean().std()

def feature_fingertip_intermittency(df, side):
    """Flexion smoothness: dimensionless jerk (intermittency) of each finger's
    tip-MCP flexion signal, averaged over index, middle, ring and pinky (thumb excluded).

    Uses the same get_intermittency() as the gross arm signal, so fine and gross
    smoothness are on the same scale (higher = less smooth). Replaces the old
    mean of signed jerk, which telescoped to (acc_end - acc_start) / duration.
    """
    vals = []
    for sp_col in _tip_mcp_speed_cols(df, side):
        j_col = sp_col.replace("_speed", "_jerk")
        if j_col not in df.columns:
            continue
        sub = df[[sp_col, j_col]].dropna()
        if len(sub) < 3:
            continue
        v = get_intermittency(sub[j_col].to_numpy(), sub[sp_col].to_numpy())
        if np.isfinite(v):
            vals.append(v)
    return np.mean(vals) if vals else np.nan

# Finger independence   
# Correlate FLEXION speeds (tip->MCP distance speed), which have wrist motion removed.
# independence = 1 - mean pairwise corr.  High = fingers move independently (native-signer-like).
def feature_finger_independence(df, side):
    pairs = [("index","middle"), ("middle","ring"), ("ring","pinky")]
    corrs = []
    for a, b in pairs:
        ca = f"{dist_col(side, FINGER_TIP_ID[a], FINGER_MCP_ID[a])}_speed"
        cb = f"{dist_col(side, FINGER_TIP_ID[b], FINGER_MCP_ID[b])}_speed"
        if ca in df.columns and cb in df.columns:
            corrs.append(df[ca].corr(df[cb]))
    return 1 - np.nanmean(corrs) if corrs else np.nan

# Speed entropy of finger flexion (variability of the signal)   
def feature_finger_speed_entropy(df, side, finger="index"):
    """Calculate the entropy of finger speed variability from distance data."""
    c = f"{dist_col(side, FINGER_TIP_ID[finger], FINGER_MCP_ID[finger])}_speed"

    hist, _ = np.histogram(df[c].dropna(), bins=30, density=True)

3 Per-file assembly
To simplify the interpretation in the later steps, we will assign to each feature (into the name) whether it belongs to gross or fine kinematics and to which category it belongs from: magnitude, variability, rhythm, coordination, proximal-distal, smoothness and handshape.
extract_gross_features and extract_hand_features each return a flat dict; extract_all merges them for one file.

def _mean_sides(fn, *dfs):
    """Call fn(*dfs, side) for each side, return nan-mean of the (scalar or tuple) results.
    Handles fns that return a scalar OR a (mean, std) tuple -> returns pooled scalar/tuple."""
    vals = [fn(*dfs, side) for side in SIDES]
    if isinstance(vals[0], tuple):
        return tuple(np.nanmean([v[i] for v in vals]) for i in range(len(vals[0])))
    return np.nanmean(vals)


def fname(name: str, domain: str, family: str) -> str:
    """Format a feature column name as domain__family__name."""
    return f"{domain}__{family}__{name}"

def extract_gross_features(df, fs):
    f = {}
    # aggregate arm-speed descriptives (uses your total_arm_* columns)
    for col, tag in [(TOTAL_ARM_SPEED, "arm_speed"), (TOTAL_ARM_ACC, "arm_acc")]:
        if col in df.columns:
            f[fname(f"{tag}_Gmean", "gross", "magnitude")]   = df[col].mean()
            f[fname(f"{tag}_Gstd",  "gross", "variability")] = df[col].std()
            pk = compute_peaks(df, col, fs)
            f[fname(f"{tag}_peak_mean", "gross", "magnitude")]   = pk["peak_mean"]
            f[fname(f"{tag}_peak_std",  "gross", "variability")] = pk["peak_std"]
            f[fname(f"{tag}_peak_n",    "gross", "rhythm")]      = pk["peak_n"]
            f[fname(f"{tag}_peak_rate", "gross", "rhythm")]      = pk["peak_rate"]
            f[fname(f"{tag}_mod_depth", "gross", "rhythm")]      = pk["mod_depth"]
    # integral / smoothness / rhythm on the total_arm signal
    if TOTAL_ARM_SPEED in df.columns:
        f[fname("arm_speed_integral", "gross", "magnitude")] = np.trapz(df[TOTAL_ARM_SPEED].values, dx=1/fs)
        f[fname("arm_speed_sampen", "gross", "rhythm")] = ent.sample_entropy(df[TOTAL_ARM_SPEED].values, order=2)
        f[fname("arm_intermittency", "gross", "smoothness")] = get_intermittency(
            df.get(TOTAL_ARM_JERK, pd.Series(dtype=float)), df[TOTAL_ARM_SPEED])
        f[fname("arm_sparc", "gross", "smoothness")] = get_sparc(df[TOTAL_ARM_SPEED].values, fs)
        for k, v in wavelet_rhythmicity(df[TOTAL_ARM_SPEED], df[TIME_COL], fs=fs).items():
            f[fname(f"{k}_totalarm", "gross", "rhythm")] = v

    # BBMV
    bbmv_total = np.nansum([get_bbmv(df, side, j) for side in SIDES for j in ARM_JOINTS])
    f[fname("bbmv_arms_total", "gross", "magnitude")] = bbmv_total

    # coordination — intrinsically bilateral, computed once (NOT side-averaged)
    f[fname("arm_coupling",  "gross", "coordination")] = compute_arm_coupling(df)
    f[fname("arm_asymmetry", "gross", "coordination")] = compute_arm_asymmetry(df)
    f[fname("proximalization_index", "gross", "proxdist")] = get_proximalization_index(df)  # already means over sides internally
    return f


def extract_hand_features(df_kin, df_dist):
    f = {}
    # geometry / handshape: mean over L and R ---
    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_adjacent_fingertip_spread, df_dist)
    f[fname("fingertip_spread_mean", "fine", "handshape")]   = m
    f[fname("fingertip_spread_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_thumb_index_distance, df_dist)
    f[fname("thumb_index_mean", "fine", "handshape")]   = m
    f[fname("thumb_index_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_mcp_tip_distance, df_dist)
    f[fname("mcp_tip_mean", "fine", "handshape")]   = m
    f[fname("mcp_tip_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_thumb_opposition, df_dist)
    f[fname("thumb_opposition_mean", "fine", "handshape")]   = m
    f[fname("thumb_opposition_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_handshape_size, df_dist)
    f[fname("handshape_size_mean", "fine", "handshape")]   = m
    f[fname("handshape_size_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    f[fname("handshape_variability", "fine", "variability")] = np.nanmean(
        [feature_handshape_variability(df_dist, side) for side in SIDES])

    # dynamics (gross-independent): mean over L and R 
    m, sd = _mean_sides(feature_fingertip_speed, df_dist)
    f[fname("flexion_speed_mean", "fine", "magnitude")]   = m
    f[fname("flexion_speed_std",  "fine", "variability")] = sd

    f[fname("flexion_intermittency", "fine", "smoothness")] = np.nanmean(
        [feature_fingertip_intermittency(df_dist, side) for side in SIDES])

    # coordination — average the two hands' independence/correlations 
    f[fname("finger_independence", "fine", "coordination")] = np.nanmean(
        [feature_finger_independence(df_dist, side) for side in SIDES])

    f[fname("flexion_entropy", "fine", "variability")] = np.nanmean(
        [feature_finger_speed_entropy(df_dist, side, "index") for side in SIDES])
    return f

def extract_all(df_kin, df_dist, fs):
    return {**extract_gross_features(df_kin, fs), **extract_hand_features(df_kin, df_dist)}

title: Feature Extraction
text:
4 Batch loop

processedfolder = os.path.join(curfolder, "Sapiens_Processed")   # <-- set curfolder above
datasetsfolder  = os.path.join(curfolder, "Datasets")

kin_files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(processedfolder, "*_kinematics.csv")))

rows = []
for kin_file in kin_files:
    print("processing", os.path.basename(kin_file))

    if os.path.basename(kin_file).startswith('LP'):
        continue

    dist_file = kin_file.replace("_kinematics.csv", "_hand_distances.csv")
    if not os.path.exists(dist_file):
        print("no distance file for", os.path.basename(kin_file)); continue

    df_kin  = pd.read_csv(kin_file)
    df_dist = pd.read_csv(dist_file)
    fid = df_kin["FileID"].iloc[0]

    fs_count = round(len(df_kin) / (df_kin[TIME_COL].iloc[-1] - df_kin[TIME_COL].iloc[0]))
    print(fs_count)
    fs = 30

    feats = extract_all(df_kin, df_dist, fs)
    feats["fileID"] = fid

    # group identification
    if "GtST" in fid:
        feats["group"] = fid.split("_")[0]
        feats["groupID"] = 'Sign'
    elif 'GP' in fid:
        feats["group"] = fid.split("_")[0]
        feats["groupID"] = 'Gesture'
    elif fid.startswith("LP") or fid.startswith("IP"):
        feats["group"] = "_".join(fid.split("_")[:2])
        if "_01_" in fid:
            feats["groupID"] = 'Learner_1'
        elif "_02_" in fid:
            feats["groupID"] = 'Learner_2'
        else:
            print('error')
            break

    elif "ViCom" in fid:
        feats["group"] = "ViCom"
        feats["groupID"] = "Sign"
    else:
        print("unparsed fileID:", fid); continue

    # concept
    try:
        if "GtST" in fid:   feats["concept"] = fid.split("_")[2].split(".")[0]
        elif "GP" in fid:   feats["concept"] = fid.split("_")[1].split(".")[0]
        elif "LP" in fid or "IP" in fid: feats["concept"] = fid.split("_")[2].split(".")[0]
        elif "ViCom" in fid: feats["concept"] = fid.split("_")[3].split(".")[0]
    except IndexError:
        feats["concept"] = np.nan
    fix = {"TO-PICK":"TO-PLUCK", "TO-MOVE-HOUSES":"TO-MOVE", "VIDEO-GAME":"VIDEOGAME"}
    feats["concept"] = fix.get(feats.get("concept"), feats.get("concept"))

    rows.append(feats)

features_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(features_df.shape, "->", features_df["group"].value_counts().to_dict() if len(features_df) else "empty")

features_df['pcnID'] = features_df['group'].str.split("_").str[0]
features_df.to_csv(os.path.join(datasetsfolder, "sapiens_features.csv"), index=False)

title: Analysis II: Bayesian multilevel models on Principal Components (1-5)
text:
In the previous script (4_PCA_featureDimensions), we used PCA to re-structure multidimensional kinematic space into fewer components. PCA is unsupervised which means that it does not know which datapoints belong to which group.
In this script, we fit one model per component with neutral cell-means coding (0 + groupID) and pull every comparison of interest after the fit with emmeans.
The main comparisons include (all in SD units, net of speaker & item):

gesture vs native sign — conventionalization, and more broadly, gesture_vs_all_signers.
learner1 – learner2 – signer progression — mainly mean(L1, L2) vs native signers, additionaly also naive_vs_beginner (L1 vs L2, within-subject), beginner_vs_native (L2 vs Sign), and mean(L1)

dir.create("models", showWarnings = FALSE)

text:
1. Config & helpers

group_levels <- c("Gesture", "Learner_1", "Learner_2", "Sign")

# ---- comparisons: weights in group_levels order (Gesture, Learner_1, Learner_2, Sign) ----
# fractional weights => each estimate is a directly interpretable mean difference in SD units.
comparisons <- list(
  # "gesture vs sign"
  gesture_vs_all_signers = c( -1, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3),  # Gesture - mean(L1, L2, Sign)
  conventionalization   = c( -1,    0,    0,   1),   # Gesture - Sign  (narrow reading)
  # "learner1 - learner2 - signer" progression
  naive_vs_beginner   = c( 0,    -1,   1,    0),   # L1 - L2  (within-subject)
  acquisition = c(0, -1/2, -1/2, 1),
  beginner_vs_native  = c( 0,    0,    -1,   1)   # L2 - Sign 
)

pr <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b"),      # group means (cell-means coding)
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)

To make the process efficient, we build functions that will allow us to fit all the models in a loop. Essentially, each model takes a component of one PCA (pooled-all, pooled-gross, pooled-fine, sign-only, sign-gross, sign-fine) and then saves the output such that it is recognizable which model the component/output belongs to.


Display helper functions
# read one domain's score file, prefix component columns with the domain ---
read_scores <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- switch(basis, varimax = "_varimax", signonly = "_signonly", "")
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("pca_scores_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(domain, "_", .x), matches("^(PC|RC)[0-9]+$"))
}

# build the modelling frame for a basis: merge all/gross/fine, harmonize concepts, factor, z-score 
build_d <- function(basis) {
  blocks <- map(c("all", "gross", "fine"), ~ read_scores(basis, .x))
  if (any(map_lgl(blocks, is.null))) return(NULL)   # a domain file missing -> skip basis
  names(blocks) <- c("all", "gross", "fine")

  comp_cols <- unlist(map(names(blocks), function(dm)
    grep(sprintf("^%s_(PC|RC)[0-9]+$", dm), names(blocks[[dm]]), value = TRUE)))

  key <- c("participant", "groupID", "concept")
  d <- reduce(blocks, full_join, by = key)

  # harmonize concept labels: native-signer English glosses -> German labels 
  # (done after the join, because the all/gross/fine score files share the original labels)
  concept_map <- read_csv(file.path("Datasets", "concept_map.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  n_before <- n_distinct(d$concept)
  d <- d %>%
    left_join(select(concept_map, concept, concept_id), by = "concept") %>%
    mutate(concept = coalesce(concept_id, concept)) %>%
    select(-concept_id)
  message("[", basis, "] concepts: ", n_before, " -> ", n_distinct(d$concept),
          " after harmonization")

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(groupID     = factor(groupID, levels = group_levels),
           participant = factor(participant),
           concept     = factor(concept)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), .names = "{.col}_z"))

  # NA report from the full joins (tokens not shared across all/gross/fine)
  na_rows <- d %>% summarise(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "component", values_to = "n_NA") %>%
    filter(n_NA > 0)
  if (nrow(na_rows)) { message("NA scores after join (", basis, "):"); print(na_rows) }

  stopifnot(all(levels(d$groupID) == group_levels))
  list(d = d, comp_cols = comp_cols)
}

# fit gaussian model for one component, cached per basis+component
fit_component <- function(comp, d, basis) {
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste0(comp, "_z ~ 0 + groupID + (1|participant) + (1|concept)")))
  brm(form, data = d, prior = pr, family = gaussian(),
      chains = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000, seed = 1,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
      file = file.path("models", paste0("brm_", basis, "_", comp)),
      file_refit = "on_change")
}

# extract all comparisons for one fit via emmeans (population-level: re_formula = NA)
extract_comparisons <- function(fit, comp, basis) {
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ groupID, re_formula = NA)     # 4 marginal means, net of RE
  w   <- if (basis == "signonly") comparisons_sign else comparisons   # 3- vs 4-group weights
  con <- contrast(emm, method = w)                    # weights positional in group order
  gather_emmeans_draws(con) %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(estimate = median(.value),
              .lower   = quantile(.value, 0.025),
              .upper   = quantile(.value, 0.975),
              pd       = max(mean(.value > 0), mean(.value < 0)),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(component = comp,
           basis     = basis,
           domain    = str_extract(comp, "^(all|gross|fine)"),
           credible  = sign(.lower) == sign(.upper))
}

# convergence diagnostics for one fit 
diagnose <- function(fit) {
  np  <- brms::nuts_params(fit)
  drw <- as_draws_df(fit)
  ess <- summarise_draws(drw, "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  tibble(max_rhat     = max(brms::rhat(fit), na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_bulk = min(ess$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_tail = min(ess$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
         n_divergent  = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]))
}

# read + tidy loadings for a basis (PC or RC id column -> prefixed `component`) 
read_loadings <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- switch(basis, varimax = "_varimax", signonly = "_signonly", "")
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("loadings_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  x  <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  id <- if (basis == "varimax") "RC" else "PC"
  if (!"sig_loading" %in% names(x) && "CI_above_null_after" %in% names(x))
    x <- rename(x, sig_loading = CI_above_null_after)     # tolerate the older column name
  x %>%
    rename(comp_id = all_of(id)) %>%
    mutate(comp_id   = as.character(comp_id),
           comp_id   = if_else(str_detect(comp_id, "^[0-9]+$"), paste0(id, comp_id), comp_id),
           component = paste0(domain, "_", comp_id),
           basis     = basis)
}

Here we define the functions that will allow us to run the models in a loop, or load them if already saved

run_basis <- function(basis) {
  bd <- build_d(basis)
  if (is.null(bd)) { message("Skipping basis '", basis, "': score files missing."); return(NULL) }
  d <- bd$d; comp_cols <- bd$comp_cols
  message("[", basis, "] modelling: ", paste(comp_cols, collapse = ", "))

  fits <- setNames(lapply(comp_cols, fit_component, d = d, basis = basis), comp_cols)

  list(
    basis     = basis,
    d         = d,
    fits      = fits,
    comp_cols = comp_cols,
    coefs     = map_dfr(comp_cols, ~ extract_comparisons(fits[[.x]], .x, basis)),
    converge  = imap_dfr(fits, ~ mutate(diagnose(.x), component = .y, basis = basis)),
    n_part    = d %>% distinct(groupID, participant) %>% count(groupID, name = "n_participants")
  )
}

load_or_run <- function(basis, cache_dir = "models", refit = FALSE) {
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("run_", basis, ".rds"))
  if (!refit && file.exists(f)) {
    message("[", basis, "] loading cached run")
    return(readRDS(f))
  }
  res <- run_basis(basis)
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    tmp <- tempfile(tmpdir = cache_dir, fileext = ".rds.part")
    ok <- tryCatch({
      saveRDS(res, tmp, compress = "xz")   # smaller files; use FALSE if speed matters more
      file.rename(tmp, f)
    }, error = function(e) {
      unlink(tmp)
      warning("[", basis, "] caching failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      FALSE
    })
  }
  res
}

Interpretation — which features drive each credible comparison
Join credible comparisons to the (basis-matched) significant loadings. Direction: a positive comparison estimate on a positively-loading feature => the first group shows more of it.

  select(basis, component, contrast, effect = estimate) %>%
  inner_join(loadings, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
  filter(sig_loading) %>%

    # signed loading (works whether obs_index is stored signed or unsigned)
    loading  = abs(obs_index) * loading_sign,
    # split leading category from the measure name
    category = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_extract(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+"),   # e.g. "gross__rwrist"

    measure  = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),  # e.g. "speed_mean"
                       variable),
    moves    = if_else(sign(effect) == sign(loading), "↑ more", "↓ less")
  ) %>%
  arrange(basis, contrast, component, category, desc(abs(loading))) %>%
  relocate(category, measure, loading, .after = component)

read_loadings_so <- function(domain) {
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("loadings_%s_signonly.csv", domain))  # adjust folder
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%

           basis       = "signonly",
           sig_loading = CI_above_null_after)
}

loadings_sign <- map_dfr(c("all", "gross", "fine"), read_loadings_so)

# guard: silent empty joins
stopifnot(nrow(loadings_sign) > 0,
          all(c("variable", "obs_index", "loading_sign", "sig_loading") %in% names(loadings_sign)))

interpretation_sign <- coefs_sign %>%
  filter(credible) %>%
  select(basis, component, contrast, effect = estimate) %>%
  inner_join(loadings_sign, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
  filter(sig_loading) %>%
  mutate(
    # split leading category ("gross__rwrist") from the measure ("speed_mean")
    has_cat  = str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
    category = if_else(has_cat, str_extract(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+"), NA_character_),
    measure  = if_else(has_cat, str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"), variable),
    # ∝ signed loading WITHIN a PC (index = loading² · eig²; eig constant per PC)
    loading_signed = loading_sign * sqrt(obs_index),
    # contrasts are (later - earlier), so this reads as "the more sign-like group has..."
    moves    = if_else(sign(effect) == sign(loading_sign), "↑ more", "↓ less")
  ) %>%
    select(basis, contrast, component, effect, category, measure, moves,
         loading_signed, obs_index, share, cum_frac, within_50pct, is_anchor, variable) %>%
  arrange(basis, contrast, component, category, desc(obs_index))

  emmeans(fits_pool[[k]], ~ groupID, re_formula = NA) %>%
    gather_emmeans_draws() %>% median_qi(.value) %>%
    mutate(component = k)) %>%
  select(groupID, component, .value, .lower, .upper)

# raw speaker means, computed from the model data of each PC 
spk_long <- map_dfr(comps, \(k) {
  fit  <- fits_pool[[k]]
  resp <- all.vars(fit$formula$formula)[1]        
  fit$data %>%
    group_by(who = as.character(groupID), participant) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[resp]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(component = k)
})

# common range for all panels
lims <- range(c(spk_long$mean, grp_long$.lower, grp_long$.upper), na.rm = TRUE)
lims <- c(floor(lims[1] * 2) / 2, ceiling(lims[2] * 2) / 2)

# one panel
pair_plot <- function(kx, ky) {
  to_xy <- function(d) d %>%
    filter(component %in% c(kx, ky)) %>%
    mutate(ax = if_else(component == kx, "x", "y")) %>%
    select(-component)

  g <- to_xy(grp_long) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ax, values_from = c(.value, .lower, .upper))

  s <- to_xy(spk_long) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ax, values_from = mean)

  a <- s %>%
    filter(who %in% c("Learner_1", "Learner_2")) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = who, values_from = c(x, y)) %>%
    drop_na()

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(data = s, aes(x, y, colour = who), alpha = .35, size = 1.8) +
    geom_segment(data = a,
                 aes(x = x_Learner_1, y = y_Learner_1, xend = x_Learner_2, yend = y_Learner_2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, "pt")), colour = "grey45", linewidth = .35) +
    geom_errorbar(data = g, width = 0, linewidth = .8,
                  aes(x = .value_x, ymin = .lower_y, ymax = .upper_y, colour = groupID)) +
    geom_errorbarh(data = g, height = 0, linewidth = .8,
                   aes(y = .value_y, xmin = .lower_x, xmax = .upper_x, colour = groupID)) +
    geom_point(data = g, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.3,
               aes(.value_x, .value_y, colour = groupID)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
    labs(x = ax_lab(kx), y = ax_lab(ky)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
}

Function to prepare table
missing <- setdiff(contr_all, unique(coefs_all$contrast))
if (length(missing)) warning("Not in coefs_all: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
                             " -> re-extract coefs / coefs_sign with the renamed comparisons")

# ===================================================================
# 1. Detailed table: one block per (basis, domain)
# ===================================================================
dim_table <- function(spec, title, file, notes_extra = NULL) {
  # spec: tibble(basis, domain, block); one row group per spec row, in that order
  spec <- spec %>%
    mutate(block = paste0(block, " (", map2_chr(basis, domain, n_info), ")"))
  keys <- select(spec, basis, domain)

  var_tab <- var_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    transmute(basis, domain, component = paste0(domain, "_PC", PC),
              variance = sprintf("%.1f%%<br>[%.1f, %.1f]<br><small>cum. %.0f%%</small>",
                                 100 * var_exp, 100 * var_low, 100 * var_high, 100 * cum_var))

  # rows = every modeled component of every PCA (not only those in the variance file)
  rows <- bind_rows(
    coefs_all %>% semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>% distinct(basis, domain, component),
    select(var_tab, basis, domain, component)
  ) %>% distinct()

  missing_var <- anti_join(keys, distinct(var_tab, basis, domain), by = c("basis", "domain"))
  if (nrow(missing_var) > 0)
    warning("No variance rows for: ", paste(missing_var$basis, missing_var$domain, sep = "/", collapse = ", "),
            ". Check the `domain` values in pca_variance_explained.csv: ",
            paste(unique(var_all$domain), collapse = ", "))

  feat_tab <- pmap_dfr(keys, read_loadings) %>%
    add_count(basis, component, name = "n_sig") %>%
    filter(within_50pct) %>%
    arrange(basis, component, desc(share)) %>%
    group_by(basis, component, n_sig) %>%
    summarise(n_top = n(),
              features = paste0(if_else(loading_sign > 0, "+", "−"), " ", pretty_feat(variable),
                                " (", round(100 * share), "%)", collapse = "<br>"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(features = paste0(features, "<br><small><i>", n_top, " of ", n_sig,
                             " significant features</i></small>")) %>%
    select(basis, component, features)

  con_tab <- coefs_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%s%.2f<br>[%.2f, %.2f]%s<br><small>pd = %.3f</small>",
                          if_else(credible, "<b>", ""), estimate, .lower, .upper,
                          if_else(credible, "</b>", ""), pd)) %>%
    select(basis, component, contrast, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = cell)

  conv_tab <- conv_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    transmute(basis, component,
              diag = sprintf("%.3f<br>%.0f<br>%d", max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, as.integer(n_divergent)))

  tab <- rows %>%
    left_join(select(var_tab, -domain), by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(pc_labels, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(feat_tab,  by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(con_tab,   by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(conv_tab,  by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(select(spec, basis, domain, block), by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    mutate(Dim = dim_of(component), block = factor(block, levels = spec$block)) %>%
    arrange(block, parse_number(Dim))

  # keep only contrasts that exist in at least one block of this table
  contr <- contr_all[contr_all %in% names(tab)]
  contr <- contr[map_lgl(contr, ~ any(!is.na(tab[[.x]])))]

  gt_tab <- tab %>%
    select(block, Dim, label, variance, features, all_of(contr), diag) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "block") %>%
    tab_header(title = title) %>%
    cols_label(.list = c(list(Dim = "Dim.", label = "Interpretation",
                              variance = html("Variance<br>explained"),
                              features = html("Features up to 50%<br>of index loading"),
                              diag     = html("R̂ / ESS /<br>div.")),
                         contr_lab[contr])) %>%
    tab_spanner("Dimension", columns = c(Dim, label, variance, features)) %>%
    tab_spanner("Group comparisons: estimate [95% CrI], SD units", columns = all_of(contr)) %>%
    fmt_markdown(columns = c(variance, features, all_of(contr), diag)) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "—") %>%
    cols_width(features ~ px(260), label ~ px(140)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(size = px(11)), locations = cells_body()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_row_groups())

  for (n in c(notes_extra, notes_base)) gt_tab <- tab_source_note(gt_tab, md(n))
  gtsave(gt_tab, file)
  gt_tab
}

# ===================================================================
# 2. Compact summary: which domain × dimension carries which trajectory
# ===================================================================
traj_map <- function(bases, title, file) {
  present <- coefs_all %>%
    filter(basis %in% bases) %>%
    distinct(basis, domain, contrast)

  cred <- coefs_all %>%
    filter(basis %in% bases, credible) %>%
    left_join(pc_labels, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%s %+.2f%s", dim_of(component), estimate,
                          if_else(is.na(label), "", paste0(" <small>", label, "</small>")))) %>%
    group_by(basis, domain, contrast) %>%
    summarise(cell = paste(cell, collapse = "<br>"), .groups = "drop")

  tab <- present %>%
    left_join(cred, by = c("basis", "domain", "contrast")) %>%
    mutate(cell = coalesce(cell, "—")) %>%                         # estimable, nothing credible
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = cell) %>%    # NA = not estimable
    left_join(select(basis_info, basis, title), by = "basis") %>%
    mutate(block  = factor(title, levels = basis_info$title[basis_info$basis %in% bases]),
           domain = factor(domain, levels = dom_levels, labels = dom_lab[dom_levels])) %>%
    arrange(block, domain)

  contr <- contr_all[contr_all %in% names(tab)]

  gt_tab <- tab %>%
    select(block, domain, all_of(contr)) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "block") %>%
    tab_header(title = title) %>%
    cols_label(.list = c(list(domain = "Domain"), contr_lab[contr])) %>%
    fmt_markdown(columns = all_of(contr)) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "n/a") %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(size = px(11)), locations = cells_body()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_source_note(md(paste(
      "Cells list the dimensions whose 95% CrI for that contrast excludes 0, with the posterior mean (SD units).",
      "— = estimable but no credible difference; n/a = contrast not estimable in that PCA (no gesturers).",
      "Dimension numbers refer to each domain's own PCA; see the detailed tables for intervals and loadings.")))

  gtsave(gt_tab, file)
  gt_tab
}
